_notes: Built by scripts/build_magneto.py (make_sounds.py + build_audio.py) into magneto/dist/~mods.

Clips: the official Discord client sounds (mp3, from discord.com/assets) and the default soundboard sounds (soundboard_*.mp3, from cdn.discordapp.com/soundboard-sounds/<id>) in magneto/discord (the 'src' folder). Clips that aren't 44.1 kHz get resampled when they're decoded.

'repeat' / 'every' / 'lead_in' (Iron ring 2, Iron ring 3 (full), Meteor M forming): game clip = lead_in s of silence, then the clip 'repeat' times, one every 'every' s. 'prev_note' is added to the preview file name.
'optional_abilities' is ignored by make_sounds; move an entry into 'abilities' to use it.

Levels: the same rule as Iron Man (target_db against the game's own volume on each file). The ally versions the game mutes (-100 dB) are never used as the reference, make_sounds levels against the self version.

abilities.name: Iron Volley

abilities.when: the orbs bursting after every volley

abilities.name: Mag-Cannon (1 ring)

abilities.name: Mag-Cannon (2 rings)
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: Go Live, a stream starts in your voice channel

abilities.name: Mag-Cannon (3 rings, full)
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: Go Live, a stream starts in your voice channel

abilities.name: Mag-Cannon hit

abilities.when: a Mag-Cannon hit (also the full-energy hit)

abilities.name: Mag-Cannon knock-back
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: airhorn from the soundboard
abilities.when: a full-ring Mag-Cannon knocks someone back (only you and the person hit hear it)

abilities.sound_desc: Discord: you deafen yourself

abilities.when: each projectile the curtain stops, can be several a second

abilities.name: Metallic Curtain down
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: you undeafen

abilities.name: Bulwark shield up

abilities.name: Bulwark shield down
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: you unmute your mic
abilities.when: the Bulwark shield breaking or running out

abilities.name: Iron ring 1
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: the test ping when you switch your headset or mic

abilities.name: Iron ring 2
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: the test ping when you switch your headset or mic

abilities.name: Iron ring 3 (full)
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: the test ping when you switch your headset or mic
abilities.when: the 3rd iron ring forming: Mag-Cannon is at full power

abilities.name: Reload
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: message ping from the ASMR sound pack (Nitro)

abilities.name: Meteor M cast
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: outgoing call, waiting for them to pick up

abilities.name: Meteor M forming
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: incoming call ringtone
abilities.when: while the meteor forms, until it's thrown
abilities.prev_note: (full ring, cut short when you throw)

abilities.name: Meteor absorbs a shot
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: 'friend started playing a game' notification

abilities.name: Meteor M thrown
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: someone joins your voice channel

abilities.name: Meteor M impact
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: you leave or drop from voice

abilities.name: Meteor M shattered
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: sad horn (sad trombone) from the soundboard
abilities.when: the meteor breaking (overload or destroyed) before it's thrown

abilities.name: Melee
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: message ping from the Lofi sound pack (Nitro)

abilities.name: Melee hit
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: quack from the soundboard
abilities.when: the melee connecting (only you hear it)

abilities.name: Magnetic Descent start
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: push to talk key pressed

abilities.name: Magnetic Descent end
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: push to talk key released

abilities.name: Metallic Chaos
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: an Activity starts in your voice channel

abilities.name: Chaos Greatsword swing
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: Discodo easter egg (click the home button 16 times)

abilities.name: Chaos Greatsword hit
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: down arrow key in the Ctrl+/ shortcuts popup (easter egg)
abilities.when: a greatsword hit (you and the person hit hear it)

abilities.name: Chaos barrage start
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: someone joins the Activity you're in

abilities.name: Chaos barrage charging
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: Stage waiting music (a Stage that hasn't started yet)

abilities.name: Chaos barrage sword
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: message ping from the Retro sound pack (Nitro)

abilities.name: Chaos barrage mark
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: a viewer leaves the stream
abilities.when: a mark being used up during the barrage (only you hear it)

abilities.name: Chaos barrage last mark
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: a stream ends
abilities.when: the last mark used up: the barrage is over (only you hear it)

abilities.name: Magnetic Resonance
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: you turn your camera on

abilities.name: Magnetic Resonance end
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: you turn your camera off
abilities.when: the projection being destroyed or recalled

abilities.name: Magneto dies
abilities.sound_desc: Discord: someone leaves your voice channel
abilities.when: Magneto dying (the body fall of every death animation)

optional_abilities.name: Metallic Chaos timer
optional_abilities.sound_desc: Discord: 'Vibe with Wumpus' lofi track (take a break screen)
optional_abilities.when: under the whole team-up (8.9 s, only you hear it)
optional_abilities.note: Quiet lofi music under the team-up, cut on the beat before 8.8 s; the music stopping is your 'time's up'. Off because the vanilla timer hum is useful info. The rare ringtone (call_ringing_beat) works here too: only you hear this one, so nobody mixes it up with the ult.
